messages.content:
Three independent readers read the same non-disclosure agreement (NDA) and decided whether it supports one statement (the hypothesis). They may agree or disagree, and a program has checked each of their quotes against the document. Your job is to make the final decision yourself, from the document.

<document>
<document 21 omitted, sha256 51bc00059fc8a198>
</document>

<hypothesis>
Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information even after the return or destruction of Confidential Information.
</hypothesis>

<readings>
<reading id="A">
label: Entailment
confidence: 92
reason: Clause 5.2 exempts from the return or destruction duty in clause 5.1 archive or back-up copies that are not reasonably retrievable and copies the Receiving Party must retain by law, and clause 5.3 confirms the Agreement continues to apply to those retained materials.
<quote check="exact">Clause 5.1 of this Agreement shall not apply to:</quote>
<quote check="exact">Copies of Confidential Information which must be retained by the Receiving Party pursuant to applicable law.</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="B">
label: Entailment
confidence: 95
reason: Clause 5.2 exempts archived/back-up copies and legally required copies from return or destruction, and clause 5.3 confirms the Receiving Party may retain such materials.
<quote check="exact">Copies of Confidential Information which must be retained by the Receiving Party pursuant to applicable law.</quote>
<quote check="exact">any documents and materials retained by the Receiving Party pursuant to clause 5.2 of this Agreement</quote>
</reading>
<reading id="C">
label: Entailment
confidence: 95
reason: Clause 5.2 exempts archived/back-up copies and legally required copies from the return or destruction obligation, so the Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information.
<quote check="exact">Confidential Information held electronically in archive or back-up systems which are not otherwise reasonably retrievable by the Representatives of the Receiving Party or its Affiliates</quote>
<quote check="exact">Copies of Confidential Information which must be retained by the Receiving Party pursuant to applicable law.</quote>
</reading>
</readings>

The readings are evidence about where to look, not votes: a majority can be wrong, and a quote marked "missing" was not found in the document. Read the relevant parts of the document yourself.

Choose exactly one label:
- Entailment: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the document states or clearly implies that the hypothesis is false.
- NotMentioned: the document does not address the hypothesis, or says too little to decide.

Evidence is required. For Entailment or Contradiction, give 1 to 3 quotes copied character for character from the document (no paraphrase, no ellipses), each as short as it can be while still carrying the point. They will be checked against the document. For NotMentioned, give an empty list.

Give a confidence from 0 to 100: your probability, in percent, that your label is correct. Give a one-sentence reason.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: label, confidence, quotes, reason.

content.text: {"label": "Entailment", "confidence": 96, "quotes": ["Clause 5.1 of this Agreement shall not apply to:", "Confidential Information held electronically in archive or back-up systems which are not otherwise reasonably retrievable by the Representatives of the Receiving Party or its Affiliates", "Copies of Confidential Information which must be retained by the Receiving Party pursuant to applicable law."], "reason": "Clause 5.2 exempts non-retrievable archive/back-up copies and legally required copies from the return or destruction obligation, so the Receiving Party may retain some Confidential Information."}
